what: Replacement collect snippet omits the required design Bash prelude
scenario_or_breakage: The next Bash block can still have empty DESIGN_TMPDIR or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so --paths-file may resolve to .output-files and the collector invocation may fail or read the wrong file
suggested_fix: Add the canonical current-design-env source line to the plan-review replacement snippet and require the collect block to use it before deriving the manifest path

what: Plan removes ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS capture but does not replace downstream tool attribution contract
scenario_or_breakage: Failure logging still needs a tool value for collect-agent-results.sh <tool> <status>; leaving ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS prose after removing the variable creates silent drift
suggested_fix: Revise plan-review.md to parse TOOL from each collect-agent-results.sh result block and remove ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS references

what: Plan assumes empty manifests are already rejected, but current dispatcher accepts slot_count=0
scenario_or_breakage: An empty slots file can emit DISPATCH_OK=true and an empty paths-file, pushing the zero-file failure downstream instead of failing at dispatch
suggested_fix: Add explicit slot_count > 0 validation in dispatch-with-waterfall.sh and test that an empty manifest exits nonzero before emitting success KVs

what: Plan hardcodes $_manifest.output-files without clearing or verifying it before dispatch
scenario_or_breakage: A failed or interrupted re-dispatch in the same DESIGN_TMPDIR could leave a stale paths-file that the later collect block consumes
suggested_fix: Add rm -f "$_manifest.output-files" before dispatch, pass --paths-file explicitly, and require the plan to abort collection if dispatch exits nonzero or ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH does not match the expected file
